caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue of a human figure standing on a rectangular, weathered wooden pedestal. The figure is dressed in a blue skirt and golden armor with detailed segments on the chest, arms, and shoes. Draped over the left shoulder and around the torso is a deep red or burgundy cloak, creating a diagonal line across the body. The statue's left arm is raised and bent at the elbow, while the right arm is down at the side. The figure wears a feathered helmet, which is gold with brown, fan-like feathers and a green accent in the center. The face is brown, with visible carved facial features and long, dark hair extending from under the helmet. The background is a plain, off-white color, and a thin, dark border frames the drawing. The artist’s name, “MINA LOWRY,” appears in small print at the bottom left corner.
title: Cigar Store Indian
